opening.argument: The video presents a practical Apple-support navigation flow for an iPhone repair issue, not a financial offer or investment solicitation. It identifies the process as contacting Apple Support, then shows the user selecting repair-related options and choosing chat: “then I want to chat with someone from Apple so I'm going to click chat.” The request for an IMEI, name, and email appears as part of that support-chat sequence, alongside a contact-information form and a Continue button. That context distinguishes the information request from a standalone solicitation, while the material does not establish whether the destination is officially authorized or whether any information was submitted.
